[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Kelly’s 1883 directory lists Joseph Glasgow as a boot manufacturer in New Town, Chesham.<ref>[https://leicester.contentdm.oclc.org/digital/collection/p16445coll4/id/39044 Kelly's Directory of Buckinghamshire, 1883 - Page 53]</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The later Chesham dossier estimates a birth around 1869 for the 1911 shoemaker. He would have been about fourteen in 1883, so these directory entries are held separately pending evidence that connects the two.

Identity resolution, 16 November 2026: no existing catalogue profile matched this record. The record defines a distinct documentary person; later life and any relationships beyond those stated in the record remain unresolved. The sourced draft is creation-ready with those limits.
